passage: The engineers tested the new bridge design twice before construction began. The first trial was a complete success. The second ______ revealed a weakness in one of the supports that had to be fixed.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
steps: "however" interrupts the sentence "The second trial revealed a weakness…"
An interrupting word in the middle of a sentence needs commas on both sides.
Missing either comma is an error; a semicolon would split the subject from its verb.
key: A conjunctive adverb in the middle of one clause is set off by two commas.
